subject: Re: Post-call: model fit & regression concerns (Olive Analytics)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Brown <sophie.brown@olive-analytics.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: model fit & next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on what you shared about Olive Analytics' summarization and entity-extraction workloads:

- Primary pain: recent version bump of the open model introduced a regression on short-summary accuracy for your retail transcripts (precision drop ~8% on our internal eval).
- Recommended initial model candidates: "redwood-mini-2.0" (fast, low-cost), "redwood-pro-quant" (best measured F1 on entity extraction), and a pinned variant of your current model (v20261101) for rollback safety.
- Evaluation artifacts I've attached:
  - Olive_PromptSet_v1.csv (your core prompts + examples)
  - eval-diffs-20261129.pdf (side-by-side diff showing the regression examples)
  - benchmark links: https://drive.redwood.com/olives/benchmarks/20261129 and the per-eval dashboard: https://app.redwood.com/evals/OLV-2026-09

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Olive to confirm 2-3 representative failure examples from your side (if you can forward the most critical 6-10 prompts).
2) Redwood to run a focused A/B eval between v20261101 (baseline) and the new variant that was deployed (v20261129) plus the two recommended candidates. Expect ~24 hours for a full pass; quick smoke in ~3-4 hours.
3) If regression confirmed on your production traffic, we can pin you to v20261101 and open a rollback window while we root-cause. Pinning is reversible and low-risk.
4) I'll loop in our infra team (Ethan) to draft a rollback/pinning runbook and timeline.

Sophie/Jordan — could you confirm the 6-10 prompts you want prioritized and whether you prefer immediate pinning while we investigate?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127

Attachments: Olive_PromptSet_v1.csv, eval-diffs-20261129.pdf

From: Sophie Brown <sophie.brown@olive-analytics.com>

Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@olive-analytics.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: model fit & next steps

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 9:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on what you shared about Olive Analytics' summarization and entity-extraction workloads:
> 
> - Primary pain: recent version bump of the open model introduced a regression on short-summary accuracy for your retail transcripts (precision drop ~8% on our internal eval).

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick follow-up and the artifacts. We attached two concrete examples (see eval-diffs-20261129.pdf) showing where the new responses omit SKU tags and mislabel product categories.

We'd prefer to be pinned to the previous model (v20261101) immediately if that's possible. The regression is visible in production and impacting downstream metrics (conversion on our recommendations). If pinning is a short operation, please proceed and we'll share the 10 high-priority prompts by EOD.

Sophie Brown
Head of ML Ops, Olive Analytics
Sophie.Brown@olive-analytics.com

Attachment: eval-diffs-20261129.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Brown <sophie.brown@olive-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: model fit & next steps

Sophie — thanks for flagging and for the examples. We can absolutely pin you back to v20261101 while we investigate. Proposed immediate plan:

1) Pin to v20261101 for Olive's production route (won't affect other customers). This is an API call and a quick config change; expected downtime = 0, config flip = ~5 minutes.
2) Open a rollback ticket (RM-OLV-482) and start a canary run on a small % of traffic to validate the pin. If canary passes for 2 hours, we'll expand to 100%.
3) Engineering (Ethan) to run a targeted A/B using Olive_PromptSet_v1.csv + your 10 prompts; we'll report per-prompt diffs and metric deltas to the dashboard.

Please confirm you'd like us to proceed with immediate pinning. Also, Sophie — can you share the 10 prioritized prompts and one representative production request-id (so we can trace logs)?

Rishi
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sophie Brown <sophie.brown@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: model fit & next steps

Quick technical notes on rollback/pinning and timeline:

- Pinning: we can create a route override for Olive that binds the route to model_id "v20261101". API: POST /routes/{route_id}/pin {"model_id":"v20261101"}. I can run this once Sophie confirms — should be a 5-10 minute change including validation.
- Rollback window: we'll keep the pinned config for up to 72 hours while the root-cause investigation runs. If we find the regression is due to a quantization/config mismatch, we can roll a hotfix and test in canary in ~24-48 hours.
- Diffs & tracebacks: please include request-ids for failed samples. I pulled the eval-diffs PDF and will run a token-level diff and KV-cache trace to determine whether tokenization or decoding settings changed between v20261101 and v20261129.
- Pinning vs version pin: pin at the route level is reversible; if you want a stronger guarantee we can provision a pinned model alias for Olive (model-alias: olive-prod-stable) which prevents automated upgrades. That requires sign-off since it blocks upstream auto-rollouts.

If you want us to proceed now, Sophie, say the word and I'll execute the pin and kick off the A/B. We'll share live logs to the eval dashboard and attach the token-diff report as soon as ready.

Ethan
Principal Engineer, Inference Platform | Redwood Inference
ethan@redwood.com

Attachment references: eval-diffs-20261129.pdf

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation of actions and owners:

- Sophie/Olive: share the 10 prioritized prompts and one representative request-id by EOD (Owner: Sophie)
- Redwood: Rishi to open RM-OLV-482 and coordinate pin (Owner: Rishi); Ethan to execute pin and run the A/B + token-diff (Owner: Ethan); Neha to draft a short RCA template and update the eval dashboard link.
- Timeline: pin now (expected <30 min end-to-end), canary validation 2 hours, full rollback/expand by EOD if canary is green. If we find a config or quantization regression, expect a 24-48 hour hotfix timeline.

Sophie — I'll also attach the MAA (managed account agreement) and a proposed SOW for the investigation/priority support (MAA_signed_SOW.pdf). If you agree to the SOW we can prioritize a dedicated slot this week for root cause.

Let's hop on a quick 30-minute sync post-pin if you want to watch live telemetry. Proposed times: 17:30 or 18:00 PT — let me know what works.

Marissa

marissa@redwood.com
